fact: PluginSettings renders RegistryManagement only while open && managementExpanded; closing Settings or collapsing disclosure unmounts the lazy view. PluginManagement additionally keys its session subtree by session ID and project scope. Current read-only behavior is appropriate.
futureRisk: A new enable/disable command whose frozen request/key and uncertain outcome live only in that lazy subtree would lose its retry authority on an ordinary close/reopen. A new mount could incorrectly allow a second command while the first is still unknown.
requiredDesign: Place the narrow command authority in an existing connection/session lifetime or use an explicit reliable protection mechanism; presentation can unmount without silently losing the original command identity.
One original request/key survives same-session disclosure close/reopen; explicit retry uses those exact bytes. Aborting transport does not establish that the server rejected the command.
On session/principal replacement, isolate late results and do not lend the new identity to an old callback. Any unresolved command handling must be explicit.
Choose the smallest actual consumer interface; do not introduce a second general outbox or duplicate public client ACK decoding.
App and AppPluginSession currently belong to Recovery original21. Future scope proposal must mark their handoff dependency; no write authority follows from this research.
candidateRegression: Start enable, close/collapse before its ACK, reopen; show the same pending/unknown command, preserve exact key/body, ignore stale-session completion, and do not issue a second POST unless the user explicitly retries the original.
distribution: Sent to existing W01 read-only proposal owner and manager. Archive only at their next natural work segment; no ACK-only project commit requested.
